description_en: Retrieves the permissions of a workspace
name: GetPermission

parameters.help_en: The workspace ID. For information about how to obtain the workspace ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html
parameters.help_zh: 工作空间ID。如何获取工作空间ID，请参见 https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the permission, which is unique within a region. For more information about permissions, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2840449.html. For information about how to obtain the permission name, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449132.html
parameters.help_zh: 权限点的名字，region内唯一。权限点介绍，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2840449.html。 如何获取权限点名称，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449132.html
parameters.name: permission_code

parameters.help_en:
The access type. Valid values:

PUBLIC: All members in the current workspace can access the instance.
PRIVATE: Only the creator can access the instance
parameters.help_zh:
访问类型，取值如下。

PUBLIC：当前工作空间所有成员都可以访问。
PRIVATE：只有创建者可以访问
parameters.name: accessibility

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud account UID of the workspace permission creator
parameters.help_zh: 工作空间权限创建者的阿里云账号UID
parameters.name: creator

parameters.help_en:
The optional configurations. Separate multiple configurations with commas (,). Valid values:
ResourceEmpty: The resource is empty. The resource is empty if Resource is not specified.
DisableRam: RAM authentication is not performed
parameters.help_zh:
可选配置，多个配置用英文逗号（,）分隔，取值：
ResourceEmpty：资源为空。如果Resource没有设置，则为空。
DisableRam：不进行RAM检查
parameters.name: option

PermissionCode.description_en: The name of the permission, which is unique within the same region. For more information about permissions, see [Appendix: Roles and permissions]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2840449.html）
PermissionCode.description_zh: 权限点的名字，同地域内唯一。权限点介绍，请参见[附录：角色及权限列表]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2840449.html）

Accessibility.description_en:
The access type. Valid values:

PUBLIC: All members in the current workspace can perform operations.
PRIVATE: Only the creator can perform operations.
ANY: Both the creator and non-creators can perform operations
Accessibility.description_zh:
访问类型，可能值：

PUBLIC：当前工作空间所有成员都可以操作。
PRIVATE：只有创建者可以操作。
ANY：创建者和非创建者都可以操作
Accessibility.title_en: 待鉴权实例的可见性 PUBLIC表示当前工作空间所有人都可以访问 PRIVATE表示只有Owner可以访问
Accessibility.title_zh: 待鉴权实例的可见性 PUBLIC表示当前工作空间所有人都可以访问 PRIVATE表示只有Owner可以访问

EntityAccessType.description_en:
The access type.
When Accessibility is set to PUBLIC, all users can perform operations and this value does not take effect.
When Accessibility is set to PRIVATE, EntityAccessType supports the following values:
CREATOR: Only the creator can perform operations.
ANY: Both the creator and non-creators can perform operations
EntityAccessType.description_zh:
存取类型。
当Accessibility为PUBLIC，所有用户都能操作，此值无效；
当Accessibility为PRIVATE，EntityAccessType支持如下值：
CREATOR：只有创建者可以操作。
ANY：创建者和非创建者都可以操作
EntityAccessType.title_en: 存取类型 CREATOR 代表能看自已创建的 OTHERS 代表可以看别人创建的 ALL代表所有
EntityAccessType.title_zh: 存取类型 CREATOR 代表能看自已创建的 OTHERS 代表可以看别人创建的 ALL代表所有
